changelog:
- Initial release of the UniFi network monitoring skill.
- Added support for querying and monitoring UniFi networks via the local gateway API.
- Provides commands for viewing device status, active clients, network health, topology, top applications (DPI), and recent alerts.
- Setup instructions and command documentation included.
- Safe, read-only GET operations for monitoring and reporting.
- Removed the skill card documentation file and added metadata file.
